{{Quote|Welcome to Bothawui your majesty! To what to we owe this great honor?''"<br />"''Your disloyalty to the Empire!|A Bothan and the Emperor|<ref name="EaW" />}}
The '''Mission to Bothawui''' was a skirmish during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prologue==
{{Quote|Moff Kalast was most forthcoming… just before the end. It seems, Tarkin, that the Bothans have chosen a side in this conflict.|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="EaW" />}}
After learning that [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan spies]] had supplied the traitorous [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kalast]] with the information about the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] he passed on to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] resolved to punish the Bothans for their treachery himself.<ref name="EaW" />

==The skirmish==
[[File:Bringyourbothanststheslaughter.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans']] punishment.]]
{{Quote|I will take care of this personally...|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="EaW" />}}
Upon landing on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] officers greeted the Emperor, and were all slaughtered by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord's]] [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and his [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] unit proceeded into the city, where Palpatine brainwashed a number of Bothans with [[Mind trick/Legends|Force corrupt]], and proceeded to destroy Bothan assets.<ref name="EaW" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You have earned the wrath of the Empire. Do not betray us again, or the cost will be even greater next time.|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="EaW" />}}
In the end, all the corrupted Bothans were turned on and killed. The Bothans later informed Palpatine that the Death Star plans were going to be beamed to the corvette [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] gathered his forces and [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|moved]] the fleet to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="EaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was the eleventh mission of the Imperial campaign in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''.<ref name="EaW" />
